register.description: Raw interrupt status reflects all pending interrupts, regardless of masking. The RIS register allows the user to implement a poll scheme. A flag set in this register can be cleared by writing 1 to the ICLR register bit even if the corresponding IMASK bit is not enabled.

Decides the channel input signal's mode. Setting the Value as 2'b11 selects the Rise Function.

When Rearm is enabled the channel remains in continuous capture mode. Otherwise it'll be in One shot capture mode. Rearm is only valid for capture mode.

STATUS
This is the system timer status register.

bitfield.description: This bit indicates if the system time is initialized and running.

This bit indicates the status of resyncup of systimer with RTC. The bitfield has a reset value of '1' , as out of reset the systimer syncs up with RTC, after the first_synced_lftick occurs the SYNCUP bit goes to zero.

bitenum.token: SYNC UP with RTC is not happening
bitenum.description: SYNC UP with RTC is not happening

bitenum.token: Any write to STATUS register, triggers the SYNCUP with RTC and this bit is set.
bitenum.description: Any write to STATUS register, triggers the SYNCUP with RTC and this bit is set.

register.description: ARMSET on read gives out the status of the 2 channels 1. Channel state UNARMED returns 0 2. Channel state CAPTURE or COMPARE returns 1 A write to ARMSET has for each channel the following effect: 1. If ARMSTA[x]==0 -> no effect 2. If ARMSTA[x]==1 and channel x is in CAPTURE state then no effect on the channel 3. Else Set channel in COMPARE mode using existing CHxVAL value

bitfield.description: Arming Channel 0 for either compare or capture operation.

bitenum.token: if channel 0 is in CAPTURE state then no effect on the channel 3. Else ; Set channel in COMPARE mode using existing CH0VAL value
bitenum.description: if channel 0 is in CAPTURE state then no effect on the channel 3. Else ; Set channel in COMPARE mode using existing CH0VAL value

bitfield.description: Arming Channel 1 for either compare or capture operation.

bitenum.token: if channel 1 is in CAPTURE state then no effect on the channel Else ; Set channel in COMPARE mode using existing CH1VAL value
bitenum.description: if channel 1 is in CAPTURE state then no effect on the channel Else ; Set channel in COMPARE mode using existing CH1VAL value

register.description: ARMCLR on read gives out the status of the 2 channels 1. Channel state UNARMED returns 0 2. Channel state CAPTURE or COMPARE returns 1 A write to ARMCLR has for each channel the following effect: 1. If ARMCLR[x]==0 no effect 2. Else Set channel in UNARMED state without triggering event unless a compare/capture event happens in the same cycle
